title: Normalized biased quadratic inequality
statement: Let $1<p<2$, $0<\alpha<\beta$, and $\alpha^p+\beta^p=1$, and let $-1\le y\le1$. Define $r=(\alpha^p\beta^{2-p}-\alpha^{2-p}\beta^p)/(\alpha^2-\beta^2)$, $u=(1+y)/\alpha$, and $v=(1-y)/\beta$. Then $(\alpha^p u+\beta^p v)^2+r\alpha^p\beta^p(u-v)^2\le((1+y)^p+(1-y)^p)^{2/p}$.
replaced: Let $1<p<2$, $0<\alpha<\beta$, $\alpha^p+\beta^p=1$, and $-1\le y\le1$. Put $r=(\alpha^p\beta^{2-p}-\alpha^{2-p}\beta^p)/(\alpha^2-\beta^2)$. Setting $u=(1+y)/\alpha$ and $v=(1-y)/\beta$, one has $(\alpha^pu+\beta^pv)^2+r\alpha^p\beta^p(u-v)^2\le((1+y)^p+(1-y)^p)^{2/p}$.
